title: vigil-sre · Estado y disponibilidad
description: Qué tan seguido respondió cada target, y cuándo no.

panels.title: Disponibilidad por target
panels.description: DEGRADED cuenta como disponible: el target respondió. La lentitud se mira en el dashboard de fases.

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  url AS target,
  COUNT(*) AS sondeos,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('UP','DEGRADED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*), 2) AS uptime_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='DEGRADED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS degradados,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS caidos
FROM probe_results
GROUP BY url
ORDER BY uptime_pct ASC

panels.title: Estado en el tiempo  (2=UP  1=DEGRADED  0=DOWN)
panels.description: Una banda por target. Los huecos son corridas que el scheduler de GitHub se salteó, no caídas.

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  CAST(strftime('%s', run_started_at) AS INTEGER) AS time,
  MIN(CASE WHEN url = 'https://www.google.com' THEN CASE status WHEN 'UP' THEN 2 WHEN 'DEGRADED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) AS "google.com",
  MIN(CASE WHEN url = 'https://www.github.com' THEN CASE status WHEN 'UP' THEN 2 WHEN 'DEGRADED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) AS "github.com",
  MIN(CASE WHEN url = 'https://www.cloudflare.com' THEN CASE status WHEN 'UP' THEN 2 WHEN 'DEGRADED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) AS "cloudflare.com",
  MIN(CASE WHEN url = 'https://httpbin.org/status/200' THEN CASE status WHEN 'UP' THEN 2 WHEN 'DEGRADED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) AS "httpbin.org"
FROM probe_results
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Targets caídos simultáneamente
panels.description: Más de uno a la vez apunta al punto de observación —el runner— y no a los targets.

targets.queryText:

  CAST(strftime('%s', run_started_at) AS INTEGER) AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS caidos
FROM probe_results
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
